$comment: Shared arena frame, from the OS standard frame (docs/research/os-arena-geometry.md). Our axes: x = goal to goal (team 0 defends x<0), y = side to side. Values describe the +x half and are mirrored.

field.$comment: Ball walls (inner faces). Corner diagonal from (cornerStartX, sideY) to (mouthX, pocketHalfWidth); goal pocket back wall at backX.

playerBounds.$comment: Walls that stop walking. A knocked player whose centre crosses this outline is KO'd (OS: any edge).
